subject: general
question: J can complete a work in 21 days, K can complete it in 42 days and L can complete it in 63 days. If J, K and L work ​together, in how many days can they complete the work?
solution:
Given:

J can complete a work in 21 days, K can complete it in 42 days and L can complete it in 63 days.

Concept used:

If A, B, and C alone can complete a task in X, Y, and Z days respectively, then they together will take = XYZ/(XY + YZ + XZ) days to complete the work.

Calculation:

Now working together, they can complete the work in

⇒ (21 × 42 × 63)/(21 × 42 + 42 × 63 + 21 × 63)

⇒ 55566/4851

⇒ 126/11

⇒ 11(5)/(11) days

**∴ They can complete the work in 11(5)/(11)days.**
